title: Developer Orbit: quickstart microflow illustrations for API auth, key rotation, streaming and tool calls
creator: Ava Martinez
attachments: Figma: Developer Orbit — quickstart frames v2 (https://figma.com/file/rdw-dev-orbit)
description: Create a compact, developer-focused illustration pack that demonstrates the end-to-end quickstart microflows for: API key creation and rotation, token-based streaming with reconnect heuristics, and a minimal tool-calling example. Assets should be usable in the public docs quickstart, the in-console first-run modal, and a short 8–12s animated GIF for marketing. Focus on clarity for engineers: show CLI/HTTP snippets side-by-side with annotated UI screenshots, callouts for common failure modes (401, reconnect), and clear success states. Provide Figma frames fully annotated for localization and implementation notes for the Docs engineering team. Prioritize export-ready slices (SVG for icons, 2x PNGs for screenshots, MP4 + GIF for animations).
acceptance_criteria: Figma file delivered with 12 annotated frames: auth flow, key rotation, streaming reconnect, tool call example
Exported assets: SVGs, 2x PNGs for each screen, MP4 short animations, loopable GIFs <= 2MB
Docs PR updated with inline images and alt text; accessibility color contrast verified
Design handoff includes code snippets, CSS tokens, and a small asset manifest for the docs pipeline
Sign-off from PM (Rao Patel) and Engineering lead (Maya Alvarez) recorded in comments
